notes.title: Patch 1.0 - Localization
notes.notes:
To streamline this build with that on other platforms, this version only adds the localization options.

Feel free to choose from one of the following:
- English
- Italian
- Spanish
- Romanian
- Greek.

notes.title: Release Announcement & Intro Guide Available
notes.notes:
Greetings!

We're excited to announce that Startup Quest Bakery launched over a week ago has already over 500 players!  

To help new players get started, we've added a comprehensive Intro Guide in the Guides section. This guide covers the basics and answers common questions about gameplay. Check it out if you need a helping hand or want to make the most of your bakery adventure.
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2907700/guides/


Thank you for your support, and happy baking!


Best regards,
Predict Edumedia team

notes.title: Final Pre-Release Update
notes.notes:
Greetings!

As we gear up for our big launch tomorrow, we're thrilled to announce the final updates and improvements:

 Fine-tuning energy systems, production, and storage.
 Enhancing the social aspects of the enterprise.
 Overhauling the expenses system.
 Updating the game help section.
 Conducting comprehensive testing with young participants in a bootcamp.
 

Thank you for your support and stay tuned for the release!

Predict Edumedia team
